answer: A durable defence is bonded reputation: each agent must lock a small stake that is slashed if it is caught running duplicate identities, and its earning history accrues slowly like water filling a lagoon, so a fresh fake account cannot instantly match an established one. Like a falcon that must be seen hunting repeatedly before it is trusted to guard the flock, an agent earns weight only through verified, costly work over time, while a zephyr of cheap new identities blows past without weight. Creating thousands of fakes then costs real stake and time, not just a signup.
